title: Power form of the interpolation bound
statement: Let $m\in\mathbb N$ and $A,B,M\in\mathbb R$ be nonnegative. If $M\le A^{1/(m+1)}B^{m/(m+1)}$, where these are real powers, then $M^{2(m+1)}\le A^2B^{2m}$.
replaced: Let $m\ge0$ be an integer and let $A,B,M\ge0$. If $M\le A^{1/(m+1)}B^{m/(m+1)}$, then $M^{2(m+1)}\le A^2B^{2m}$, with every zero base to the zero power interpreted as one.
